expectations.text: The model the agent built from the words is among the run's outputs (a Promela-subset file, or an IR document when the experimental direct-IR route was taken)
The route the skill prescribes was taken: the model is written in the Promela subset, not authored directly as IR
The mutual-exclusion question is asked of the engine as a property, not answered by reading the model
The mutual-exclusion question was answered by the engine: a state property (invariant or assert) verified with evidence exhaustive in a report among the outputs
expectations.evidence: no engine report under outputs matching {'kind': ['invariant', 'assert'], 'status': 'verified', 'evidence': 'exhaustive'}: no *.json files

expectations.text: The deadlock question is answered from the engine's own deadlock property
expectations.evidence: no engine report under outputs matching {'property': 'deadlock', 'status': 'verified', 'evidence': 'exhaustive'}: no *.json files

expectations.text: The answer names the extra assumption of a self-built model: the verdict holds for the model, and that the model matches the words is a separate claim
The modelling decisions the words did not fix are named (channel kind or capacity, ordering, what the working section is)
No forbidden phrasing, and the self-built model is not presented as a result about the described system itself (a line that rejects the word does not count)
expectations.evidence: pattern "(?im)^(?![^\\n]*(не\\s|нельзя|не говор|not |never |avoid|do not|don't|forbidden|запрещ))[^\\n]*(\\bno errors\\b|ошибок нет|\\bproved\\b|\\bproven\\b|доказано|система корректна|system is correct)" absent
